thread:
maria: Hey all — planning a small engine patch + quant-profile tweak during a quiet window on Thu 02:00 UTC. Low-risk, but want a clear owner, smoke steps, and rollback readiness. CR: https://github.com/redwood/infer/pull/4923. Who can own? :eyes:
aj: I can take the deploy. Patch looks straightforward. I’ll claim 02:00-03:30 UTC. I’ll do canary on 10% slice first, then full sweep if green. What exact smoke do you want?@katie can you watch metrics?
katie: Yep I can watch latency/cost dashboards and the eval diff. Smoke I’d run: simple health, quick sample gen, and a small eval set. Paste below — keep short so it fits in the window.
```
# smoke checklist (run from ops box)
kubectl --context prod exec -it runtime-canary-0 -- curl -fsS http://localhost:8080/health || exit 1
python infra/tools/run_eval.py --model local/canary --prompts smoke/prompts.json --limit 10 --output /tmp/smoke.json
jq -r '.[] | .response' /tmp/smoke.json | head -n 5
# basic token-rate sanity: influx query or prometheus check (one-liner)
```
leo: Deploy-bot: CI + smoke image build status?
deploy-bot: CI: build passed, integration tests passed, docker image pushed: gcr.io/redwood/runtime:patch-4923. (artifact id: sha256:abcd1234) :white_check_mark:
aj: Rollback plan: if any regressions, I will immediately flip traffic back to tag `release/v1.2.8` and trigger hotfix pipeline. Steps: 1) set routing weight to previous model variant, 2) trigger rollback tag, 3) open follow-up issue. I’ll post the exact commands in the runbook before deploy.
maria: Thanks — small ask: please run the sample eval before shifting to 50% and paste outputs here (first 3 responses). Also annotate any token-rate delta >10%.
katie: Ack. I’ll watch dashboards and set a regression alert for eval score drop >2 points. I’ll also be on-call for 02:00-04:00 UTC.
aj: Noted. I’ll post status updates in this thread: staging smoke -> canary 10% -> samples -> canary 50% -> full. If anything odd, we rollback immediately.
maria: Perfect. If anyone else wants to be on-deck for takeover, ping here. Otherwise I’ll mark the owner in the calendar. :thumbsup:
